headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 14, 2026**
article:
The Baltimore Orioles have transferred left-handed pitcher Keegan Akin from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort, affecting his availability for the remainder of the season. The Milwaukee Brewers made a midseason trade, sending RHP Easton McGee to the Kansas City Royals in exchange for cash.

Injuries and availability impact are affecting several teams. Keegan Akin (Baltimore Orioles) has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort. Zac Gallen (Arizona Diamondbacks) has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 9, 2026, with right elbow inflammation. Chris Martin (Texas Rangers) has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder impingement. Nick Lodolo (Cincinnati Reds) has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a blister on his left index finger. William Kempner (Miami Marlins) has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a right elbow sprain. Brandon Woodruff (Milwaukee Brewers) has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation. Mike Yastrzemski (Atlanta Braves) has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left elbow inflammation. Anthony Banda (Minnesota Twins) has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left lat strain.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Milwaukee Brewers traded RHP Easton McGee to the Kansas City Royals for cash. The Baltimore Orioles acquired RHP Cam Sanders from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers acquired SS Braden Shewmake from the Houston Astros. The Chicago White Sox traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations.
